answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated interpretation, we report BLEU (similarity between generation and ground truth), PPL (fluency of generated sentences), and Inter Repetition (diversity of generated explanations).

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation: We conduct human evaluation to further evaluate the effectiveness of MPII. We randomly selected 300 examples from the test set of e-SNLI, and asked 4 well-educated annotators to rate every sample with 4 metrics on a 1-5 Likert scale in a strictly blind fashion.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each sample on a 1-5 Likert scale for four metrics.
